items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I joined a more successful band known as Lloyd Hunter. ... Lloyd Hunter was the first good professional band that I played with.

ctx.x: Yes, I am. Yes, I am. Well, in staying with that band you began to be able to cope with reading the music, for instance, or your reading was improving that much, was it? Or had it already improved that much?

Yes. I had been challenged and I had been encouraged to study more. Now, this all comes slowly and it came slowly. And I'm still studying music as most musicians do. So in my desire to better myself I realized that I had to study, so in the process I started to studying music more seriously, and learning to read better, and also learning to write. And it was during this time that I left this first band that I played with, because they weren't working regularly enough and I had learned from the experience in St.…
Yes, I see. How long did you stay with Lloyd Hunter?
